title: Pantheon SignalInference
description: First-class decision object that records the inferred trading signals (direction, magnitude, confidence) for each instrument in the selected universe. This is stage 3 of the five-stage decision chain (RegimeState → UniverseSelection → SignalInference → AllocationDecision → RiskAdjudication). Signal inference transforms market data and regime context into actionable trade directives.

signal_id.description: Unique identifier for this signal inference batch.

strategy_id.description: The strategy this signal inference applies to.

artifact_id.description: The strategy/model artifact version that produced these signals.

version.description: Version of this signal inference record.

regime_id.description: The regime_id from the upstream RegimeState that contextually frames this inference.

regime_ref.description: Cached reference to the regime context. Signals are regime-conditioned.

universe_id.description: The universe_id from the upstream UniverseSelection that defines the eligible instruments.

universe_ref.description: Reference to the upstream UniverseSelection. Signals must only reference instruments in this universe.

symbol.description: The instrument symbol. Must be present in the referenced universe.

instrument_type.description: BG-000 instrument_type vocabulary for this signal target (for example equity, future, option, or crypto_pair).

security_master_ref.description: Optional SecurityMaster ID for provenance linkage.

contract_master_ref.description: Optional ContractMaster ID for derivatives provenance linkage.

magnitude.description: Signal strength or expected return magnitude. Units depend on the signal model.

time_horizon.description: Intended holding period for this signal.

signal_type.description: The family or class of the signal model.

raw_score.description: Unnormalized model output before scaling to magnitude.

feature_snapshot.description: Key feature values that drove this signal, stored for replay.

signals.description: Per-instrument signal directives. May be empty if no signals pass the inference threshold.

evaluated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this signal inference was computed.

input_refs.description: Upstream objects consumed for signal inference. Must include regime_state and universe_selection refs.

output_refs.description: Downstream decision objects that reference this signal inference.

model_family.description: The signal model family. Distinguishes first-class decision provenance from raw research artifacts.

model_version.description: Version or commit of the signal model.

hyperparameters.description: Key hyperparameters used during inference for exact replay reproducibility.

decision_reasoning.description: Summary reasoning for the signal inference batch. May include model interpretation, feature importance, or regime-signal interaction notes.

inference_stats.description: Summary statistics about the signal batch for audit and replay.

total_universe_size.description: Number of instruments in the referenced universe.

signals_emitted.description: Number of instruments with non-neutral signals.

market_scope.description: Inherited BG-000 market_scope envelope for this signal batch, including the BG-001 master or dataset IDs that bound replay for these signals.

state.description: Lifecycle state of this signal inference record.

superseded_by.description: signal_id of a newer signal inference that supersedes this one.
